question: ICC World Cup (cricket) 2023 was hosted by ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **ICC World Cup (cricket) 2023** was hosted by **India**.
 
• This was the 13th edition of the ICC Cricket World Cup.
 
• India has previously co-hosted the World Cup in **1987, 1996, and 2011**.
 
• The tournament featured 10 teams competing for the prestigious trophy.
 
• Matches were played in various cities across India, showcasing the country's rich cricketing culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The ICC Cricket World Cup is organized by the **International Cricket Council (ICC**) every **four years**.
 
• It is one of the most viewed sporting events globally, attracting millions of viewers.
 
• The first ICC Cricket World Cup was held in **1975 **in **England**.
 
• Australia has won the tournament the most times, with a total of five victories.
 
• The 2019 ICC Cricket World Cup was hosted by England and Wales, with England emerging as the champions.
